title: Setup, Linux basics and Git
summary: First day: set up my Ubuntu server, hit three different SSH errors and fixed them, learned how Linux groups really work, and resolved my first Git merge conflict.

title: JavaScript core, Node.js and a password generator
summary: Learned the JavaScript basics properly, set up Node.js, and built a secure password generator with tests that I saw both pass and fail. This one took me two days.

title: Async JavaScript and debugging
summary: Learned how the event loop decides the order of code, why Promise.all is faster, how to read a stack trace, and how to pause a program with breakpoints in VS Code and Chrome DevTools.

title: Ports, TCP and sockets
summary: Built a TCP echo server on my Ubuntu machine, watched the three-way handshake with tcpdump, scanned ports with nmap, and learned why 'connection refused' and 'timed out' point to different problems.

title: DNS and HTTP from first principles
summary: Traced my own domain from the root servers, built an HTTP server with no framework on my Ubuntu machine, typed HTTP requests by hand, and broke every step of loading a page to learn which error message belongs to which step.

title: Debugging from the browser with DevTools
summary: Built a page with bugs on purpose and found each one from Chrome DevTools: uncaught errors in the Console, failed requests in the Network tab, a CORS block, a crashed server, and why 'Failed to fetch' alone tells you nothing.

title: React fundamentals, VaultLab's first front end
summary: Started VaultLab's real front end with React and Vite: components, props, state and loading data through a proxy. Then broke it in eight ways, including a white screen and a key bug that revealed the wrong password.

title: Express.js, VaultLab's real API
summary: Built VaultLab's real API with Express: REST routes with validation, a request logger, one error handler and a JSON 404, and connected the React app so items survive a reload. Then broke it in eight ways, and found out my firewall had been off the whole time.
